integrity: The finite field, defining set, trace code, and generator are reconstructed independently from the published data. The published ordinary weight enumerator is reproduced exactly before higher-dimensional calculations are accepted. All \(417198\) positive-dimensional message subspaces are enumerated once in reduced-row-echelon form and their support unions are exhaustively counted.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite classification for the \(m=8\), \(a_1=\alpha\), \(a_2=\alpha^2\) code in Example 1. It does not give an all-\(m\) formula for Theorem 3.6 or classify the extremal subcodes up to automorphism.
title: Complete higher-support profile of the Gold-type \([51,8,20]\) self-orthogonal code
